# Senator Example Announces Drug Pricing Legislation

WASHINGTON — Today Senator Example introduced H.R. 1234, a bill aimed at lowering
prescription drug prices through expanded Medicare negotiation authority. The measure
has drawn intense interest from the pharmaceutical lobby.

"Families should not have to choose between medicine and rent," the Senator said in a
statement. Industry groups, including clients represented by Acme Strategies LLC, have
spent heavily opposing similar provisions in prior quarters.

The bill now heads to committee, where Global Pharma Inc. and other stakeholders are
expected to weigh in during markup.
